backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor that includes blob storage mixin and defines Nakshatra data structure with initialization of all 27 nakshatras including their names, images, descriptions, ruling deities, symbols, and characteristics.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting completed changes including title updates, header text replacements, and removal of pada sections from various frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose, including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and configuration files for the Nakshatra tracking application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a dark theme color system using OKLCH color space for cosmic aesthetic with purple/violet primary colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Star Field Explorer' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, nakshatra details, and admin pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster components.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner component displaying the current nakshatra with Moon icon and basic information, linking to the detail page with simplified design (pada breakdown removed).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Caffeine.ai attribution with UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with 'Star Field Explorer' branding, Moon icon, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin sections.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component providing consistent structure with Header, main content area using React Router Outlet, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a responsive grid of all 27 Nakshatras as clickable cards with images, highlighting the current Nakshatra based on moon position and linking to detail pages.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Provides an image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, and progress indication for Nakshatra images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Returns the current Nakshatra based on moon position, refreshing every 5 minutes to keep data current.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and auth client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: Defines a React Query mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data via the backend actor, invalidating relevant queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch all Nakshatras or a single Nakshatra by name, ensuring backend initialization before queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark-themed color palette using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing Nakshatra details including image upload, description, deity, symbol, and characteristics with form validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays all 27 Nakshatras in a grid with edit buttons, loading skeletons, and error handling using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying the app title, Nakshatra explanation text, current Nakshatra banner, and a grid of all Nakshatras.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for individual Nakshatras showing image, metadata, tabbed content sections, and highlighting when the Moon is currently in that Nakshatra.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Core astronomical calculation engine that defines the 27 Nakshatras with their degree ranges and calculates the Moon's current ecliptic longitude using Julian Day and simplified Meeus algorithms.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Data structure and content for Nakshatra pada subdivisions, containing detailed descriptions for each of the four padas within each Nakshatra including degree ranges, navamsa signs, and interpretations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, extended theme properties, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking completed features (title updates, header text changes, pada removal) and pending feature requests for the Star Field Explorer Nakshatra tracking application.
